user.title: Configure the media controller
user.description: Select the Music Assistant player. The {profile} drives up to {slot_count} room controls; leave a slot empty to hide that tile. Labels are optional and fall back to the entity name.

error.not_music_assistant: Select a media player provided by Music Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Music Assistant player is already configured.

init.title: Controller options
init.description: Remap the player or the room controls of the {profile}, which drives up to {slot_count} of them. The integration reloads automatically.

error.not_music_assistant: Select a media player provided by Music Assistant.
error.already_configured: This Music Assistant player is already used by another controller.

user.title: Add a panel
user.description: Select the kind of device. How many room controls it can drive is decided by the device itself.

slots.title: Room controls
slots.description: The {profile} drives up to {slot_count} room controls. Leave a slot empty to hide that tile. Labels are optional and fall back to the entity name.

reconfigure.title: Room controls
reconfigure.description: The {profile} drives up to {slot_count} room controls. Leave a slot empty to hide that tile. Changing the device type is not possible; remove the panel and add it again.

refresh.name: Refresh controller data
refresh.description: Refresh queue and playlist data immediately.

play_queue_item.name: Play queue item
play_queue_item.description: Start a Music Assistant queue item without replacing the queue.
